source: https://ara.so/ (fetched 2026-08-03; site is agent-friendly — every page has a .md twin plus /llms.txt — so extraction combines the markdown site map, both CSS bundles (marketing + app), and downloaded imagery; hero DOM is client-rendered so runtime visuals not observed)
assets read: marketing-*.css (210KB), styles-*.css (982KB app tokens), /index.md, /llms.txt, tonalist-landscapes/ imagery
product_context: Ara — 'The Multiplayer Coding Agent' / autonomous software engineer for GitHub: connect a repo, assign issues, cloud agents open evidence-backed PRs with screen recordings and logs; positions itself as a 'software factory'

color.palette_type: two token systems: marketing pages on sage-tinted paper with ink text and quiet status hues; the app on an editor-chrome metaphor (chrome/sidebar/editor tokens) with a color-mix opacity ladder

marketing.status: green #128347/#e4f3e9, red #bd3030/#fde8e8, amber #9b6500/#fff2d2; 'blue' is literally #202124 near-black — the marketing layer refuses a blue accent
marketing.shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(24,31,27,.08) — one soft ambient shadow token
marketing.note: every neutral is green-tinted (paper, lines, muted text) — a faint botanical cast over an otherwise monochrome page

app.metaphor: tokens named after an IDE: --chrome #ffffff, --sidebar #f3f3f3, --editor #ffffff (dark: #181818/#1f1f1f/#181818), --base #141414 ink
app.opacity_ladder: text and borders derived from one --base via color-mix: text 100/74/60%, borders 20/12/8% — the whole neutral system is one color at different alphas
app.accent: #2778c1 blue (dark #5da1e5), purple #7565cc; --ara-blue-gradient layers radial washes of the accent for feature surfaces
app.status: success #007041, danger #be1744, warn #a46700 — all with color-mix soft variants
app.diff_tokens: GitHub-style diff palette (#e6ffec/#ffebe9 add/del backgrounds, #2da44e/#cf222e bars) — PR review is core UI

color.contrast_strategy: near-black ink on tinted paper; marketing stays essentially monochrome-green, app reserves orange for brand and blue for interactive accents

typography.heading_font: Helvetica Now Display — the whole site runs on one licensed Helvetica revival at weight 400–450
typography.heading_scale: modest and light: hero h1 38px, section h2 34px/1.12, statement h2 48px/400/1.06, pricing price 42–50px at weight 450; no heavy weights anywhere — hierarchy by size and space, not boldness
typography.font_style_notes: neo-grotesque restraint: regular-weight Helvetica headlines with near-zero tracking (-.02em max) give a Swiss-document tone; Geist Mono carries terminal/evidence artifacts

spacing.content_density: marketing comfortable with hairline-separated sections (hero has border-bottom 1px var(--line)); app compact (280px sidebar, 480px detail panel tokens)
spacing.section_rhythm: hero capped at min(680px, 100vh-104px) — controlled, not full-bleed dramatic

layout.grid_system: hero: asymmetric 2-col grid (.9fr copy / .62fr visual); centered statement sections (max 920–980px); app: fixed-width sidebar + detail panel shell
layout.structure_from_sitemap: large product surface: Sessions, CLI/Devices, Web & Mobile, Slack, Jira/Linear, Automations, Review, QA, Security, Code Review, AutoWiki, Software Factory, Computers, Analytics, Agent Readiness, Model Routing, Repo Memory + enterprise/use-cases/blog — a many-page marketing site with one shared template
layout.agent_native_site: the site itself is built for AI consumption: /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, .md twin for every URL, Accept: text/markdown supported — the medium repeats the product pitch
layout.alignment: left-aligned hero copy, centered statement sections

shape.radius_scale: 8px is the workhorse (106 uses), 999px pills for all CTAs (68), 14px for painting-backed feature cards, 5–9px middles; buttons are full pills (46px tall, ink fill, panel-white text)
shape.border_usage: 1px var(--line) hairlines on cards and section splits; .5px shell dividers in-app

elevation.shadow_style: single soft ambient token on marketing (0 18px 48px at 8% ink); app menus 0 8px 22px; flat otherwise
elevation.depth_cues: paper/panel two-level surfaces + hairlines; paintings supply all the visual depth

motion.philosophy: minimal, purposeful: 4 keyframes total in 210KB of marketing CSS
motion.keyframes_observed: home-hero-content-in (entrance), home-mini-spin (loader), marketing-logo-marquee (customer logo loop), pricing-connector-swap; tooltip fades 70ms in / 250ms out

components.button_primary: pill, min-height 46px, ink (#171918) fill, panel-white label, weight 400
components.painting_cards: signature component: feature/CTA cards backgrounded by 19th-century paintings under a subtle darkening gradient (linear-gradient(180deg,#0808080a,#08080866)), 8–14px radius, 1px line border, white text
components.evidence_artifacts: product surfaces render PR diffs (GitHub diff tokens), terminal transcripts (Geist Mono), screen-recording frames — proof-of-work as UI
components.pricing: tier cards with 42–50px light-weight prices; workflow cards with 40px statement strong text
components.logo_marquee: customer logos in a CSS marquee loop

design_style.personality: a 'software factory' that decorates with Hudson River School landscapes — the tension IS the brand: autonomous industrial tooling presented with the stillness of 19th-century American tonalist painting; Swiss-neutral Helvetica typography stays out of the paintings' way
design_style.genre: AI dev-tool marketing, painterly-pastoral school — the emerging counter-aesthetic to terminal-dark AI branding (Cursor's 2025+ warm rebrand is the same school); Ara commits hardest by using real catalogued paintings
design_style.visual_language: sage-tinted monochrome paper, hairline rules, regular-weight type — then full-color oil paintings (Whittredge's Second Beach Newport, Inness's Lackawanna Valley and Tiber views, Kensett's Genesee, Heade's Rio de Janeiro Bay — an actual /tonalist-landscapes/ collection, numbered like a catalog) as hero art and card backdrops with gentle scrims; filter saturate(.96) contrast(1.04) tunes them
design_style.composition: asymmetric hero (copy left, product visual right) over a bordered baseline; statement sections centered at 48px/400; paintings appear wherever emotion is needed, product evidence (diffs, transcripts, recordings) wherever proof is needed
design_style.copy_voice: declarative single-sentence value props with a literary cadence: 'Your backlog ships itself', 'Every fix ships with proof it works', 'The ticket walks itself to review', 'Notes from the software factory', 'Evidence, not a claim'; lowercase 'ara' sometimes; zero exclamation marks
design_style.interaction_feel: quiet — fast tooltip fades, one marquee, entrance animation on the hero; the site reads more than it moves

overview.performance_tier: lightweight — CSS-only animation, JPEG paintings; no canvas/WebGL/JS animation libraries
overview.composite_notes: Homepage body is client-rendered (main-*.js), so live hero behavior unverified; token CSS, class inventory, and the .md site map give high-confidence structure. The signature 'effect' is curatorial, not technical: a numbered collection of public-domain tonalist landscape paintings.

painting_backdrops.details: feature cards and hero art set on /tonalist-landscapes/NN-artist-title.jpg backgrounds (Whittredge, Inness, Kensett, Heade) under 4–40% black gradient scrims, saturate(.96) contrast(1.04); an art-collection-as-design-system

logo_marquee.details: marketing-logo-marquee CSS loop for customer logos

blue_gradient_washes.details: app feature surfaces use --ara-blue-gradient: two radial accent washes + a diagonal veil, all color-mix derived from one accent
